biRate.context: Hiked +50bp to defend rupiah amid global volatility

BBCA.JK.name: Bank Central Asia

Business.segments: Retail banking dominant; SME, corporate, treasury; subsidiaries in syariah, finance, insurance
Business.moat: Lowest cost-of-funds franchise in Indonesia (85% CASA); 27M+ customers; market-leading digital platform (myBCA, BCA Mobile)
Business.marketShare: Largest private bank; #3 by assets after BMRI and BBRI

BBCA.JK.rationale: Quality compounder with fortress capital (26.95% CAR) and unmatched CASA franchise. But 3.0× P/B already prices in 24% ROE; NIM compression (-40bp YoY) signals competitive yield pressure. Hold for defensive book exposure.

BMRI.JK.name: Bank Mandiri

Business.segments: Largest by assets; balanced corporate, retail, SME, syariah; conglomerate value chain
Business.moat: State-owned utility-like position with massive scale; deep SOE/corporate relationships; large CASA base 71.6%
Business.marketShare: Largest bank by assets in Indonesia

BMRI.JK.rationale: Best Q1 momentum (+16.6% profit), lowest NPL among peers (0.98%), trading at 7.2× P/E and 1.37× P/B for 19% ROE. 9.67% yield with sustainable 77% payout. Top pick for value + quality balance.

BBRI.JK.name: Bank Rakyat Indonesia

Q1_2026.note: Highest NIM in coverage; cost-of-credit improvement key thesis driver

Business.segments: Microfinance leader (Ultra Micro Holding with PNM, Pegadaian); SME, retail, corporate; 90,000+ touchpoints
Business.moat: Unmatched rural and ultra-micro distribution; 30M+ micro/SME borrowers; highest NIM in system at 7.9%
Business.marketShare: Largest by customer base; #2 by assets

BBRI.JK.rationale: Highest yield (11.3%) backed by record microfinance NIM (7.9%) and improving LAR (4.8% vs 6.6% PY). 91% payout is high but covered by stable 18% ROE. Asset quality recovery is the key catalyst.

BBNI.JK.name: Bank Negara Indonesia

Q1_2026.at1Issuance: USD 700M in April 2026 to strengthen capital

Business.segments: Corporate banking heavy (BNI Direct); growing digital retail (Wondr by BNI, 5.4M users at YE25)
Business.moat: International network (NY, London, Tokyo, etc.) supporting cross-border corporate; recent digital pivot via Wondr/BNIdirect

BBNI.JK.rationale: Trading below book (P/B 0.88×) reflecting weakest profitability profile: 12% ROE vs peers 17-24%, NIM compressing to 3.5-3.8%, aggressive 20% loan growth raising credit-cost question. Cheap but for reason. Wait for Wondr-driven CASA mix improvement to validate the digital transformation thesis.

fiveYearMetrics._note: Selected key metrics across cycle. Sourced from each bank's annual reports (BBCA, BMRI, BBRI, BBNI) via Samuel Sekuritas, Bahana, MNC Securities sell-side reports and IR investor presentations.
